title: Australian Property Sales Exceed Expectations in Inner City Markets
summary: Two semi-detached properties in inner city Australian markets sold for prices significantly above their reserve. In Sydney's inner west, a semi-detached house sold for $2.91 million, with the buyer intending for their children to live there during university. In Melbourne's inner north, another semi-detached home sold for $917,500, exceeding its reserve by over $110,000.
summary_points: A semi-detached house in Sydney's inner west sold for $2.91 million.
The Sydney buyer plans to use the property for their children attending university.
A semi-detached property in Melbourne's inner north sold for $917,500.
The Melbourne sale exceeded its reserve price by more than $110,000.
